cases.name: empty-frame
cases.description: No hands and no pose. The vector must still be exactly 159 finite floats.

cases.name: pose-only
cases.description: Torso visible, no hands. Only the pose flag should be set.

cases.name: left-hand-only
cases.description: Single left hand, no pose. Centroid features must stay zero.

cases.name: both-hands-open
cases.description: Open left and right hands with pose, the ordinary case.

cases.name: both-hands-curled
cases.description: Curled fingers, to exercise the extension-angle block (indices 148-157).

cases.name: duplicate-handedness-higher-score-wins
cases.description: Two right hands: the higher-scoring one must occupy the right slot.

cases.name: duplicate-handedness-lower-score-first
cases.description: Same as above with the order reversed, to prove selection is order-independent.

cases.name: incomplete-hand-ignored
cases.description: A hand with 20 landmarks is unusable and must be treated as absent.

cases.name: hand-with-nan-coordinates
cases.description: Non-finite coordinates must be replaced with zero, never propagated.

cases.name: degenerate-hand-zero-scale-guard
cases.description: All landmarks identical: the scale guard must prevent a division by zero.

cases.name: tiny-hand-scale-invariance
cases.description: A 0.004x hand must normalise to nearly the same vector as the open hand.

cases.name: huge-hand-scale-invariance
cases.description: A 40x hand must normalise to nearly the same vector as the open hand.

cases.name: pose-missing-shoulders
cases.description: Pose present but shoulder landmarks are not finite: pose flag must be 0.

cases.name: pose-truncated-array
cases.description: Pose with fewer than 13 landmarks must be handled without an index error.

cases.name: zero-width-shoulders
cases.description: Both shoulders at the same point: the width guard must zero the centroid block.

cases.name: unmirrored-camera-handedness
cases.description: Handedness labels are whatever MediaPipe reported; the feature code must not swap them.

cases.name: realistic-generated-frame
cases.description: A frame from the same generator the smoke test uses, with both hands and pose.

cases.name: hand-count-zero-with-stale-pose
cases.description: No hands but a valid pose: hand count 0, pose flag 1.

valueEncoding: JSON cannot represent non-finite numbers. The strings "NaN", "Infinity" and "-Infinity" appear in `frame` and must be decoded to the corresponding JavaScript number before the frame is passed to extractFeatureVector(). `expectedVector` is always finite.
